At the conclusion of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], two [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] named [[Vaz Traniff]] and [[Combo]] teamed with a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to '''raid''' the Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']].
